title: Mystic Herbalist
description: A hooded figure with purple skin and ornate red and green robes sits at a marble table, hands hovering over an open spellbook filled with glowing butterfly-like illustrations and arcane script. The table holds a glowing red potion bottle with a golden insect, a purple dish with crystals and a luminous blue gem, scattered scrolls, and hanging mistletoe and lanterns above.
prompt: A mystical hooded figure with purple skin wearing ornate red and green robes sits at a cracked marble table in a dimly lit chamber, hands gesturing over a large open spellbook displaying glowing teal and purple butterfly illustrations and magical runes. On the table are a glowing red potion bottle with a golden insect inside, a purple dish containing crystals and a bright blue gem, scattered scrolls, hanging mistletoe and a red lantern overhead casting warm light, mystical atmosphere, detailed digital fantasy art
